items.speaker: A
items.text: Hey. Sorry I'm a minute late.

items.speaker: B
items.text: No worries. I just got here too.

items.speaker: A
items.text: Cool. This place is nice. I'm Aakash.

items.speaker: B
items.text: Nice to meet you, Aakash. I'm Kishan.

items.speaker: System
items.text: Kishan's tone sounds warm. Take a steady breath and keep your reply simple.

items.speaker: A
items.text: So... first time here, or are you a regular?

items.speaker: B
items.text: First time. I picked it because the reviews were friendly.

items.speaker: A
items.text: Okay, same. I read three reviews and started overthinking it.

items.speaker: System
items.text: A is showing nerves. Keep your shoulders relaxed and slow down slightly.

items.speaker: B
items.text: You're not alone. I checked the menu twice.

items.speaker: A
items.text: Good. I was worried you were effortlessly chill.

items.speaker: System
items.text: Aakash's smile sounds genuine. You're safe to share a little more.

items.speaker: B
items.text: I'm pretty easygoing, but I was a little nervous too.

items.speaker: A
items.text: Relatable. So what have you been up to lately?

items.speaker: B
items.text: Work's been busy. I still try to get outside and read when I can.

items.speaker: System
items.text: Ask one follow-up question. Keep it short and specific.

items.speaker: A
items.text: Nice. Any good book recommendations?

items.speaker: B
items.text: I just finished one I loved. I can text you the title.

items.speaker: A
items.text: That sounds great. Thanks. This is going better than my brain predicted.

items.speaker: System
items.text: Good moment to smile and pause. Let the other person respond.

items.speaker: B
items.text: Same here. I'm glad we did this.
